title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build the skills to prepare data, train models and deploy reliable ML systems.

cards.title: Orientation
cards.summary: See how the career path is structured and how each unit builds toward real machine learning work.
cards.reason: A clear map makes it easier to understand what you are building toward and how each part of the path supports real machine learning work.
goals: Understand how the path is organised
Recognise the stages of a machine learning workflow

cards.title: Python Foundations
cards.summary: Learn to write clear Python programs, use variables, and turn simple ideas into working code.
cards.reason: Python is the working language used throughout the Machine Learning path. These foundations let you express instructions, store information and control what a program does.
goals: Use expressions to calculate new values
Read a short program and predict its result

lessons.title: Writing Programs
lessons.description: Turn ideas into simple programs a computer can run.

lessons.title: Using Variables
lessons.description: Store information your programs can use.

lessons.title: Input and Output
lessons.description: Make a program respond and show its result.

lessons.title: Program Flow
lessons.description: Guide a program through steps and decisions.

cards.title: Data & Math Foundations
cards.summary: Build the data and math intuition you need to understand how machine learning models work.
cards.reason: Models learn from numbers and relationships. This region gives you the vocabulary to inspect data and understand what a model is measuring.
goals: Use the core maths behind simple models
Reason about probability and relationships in data

cards.title: EDA & Features
cards.summary: Explore datasets and shape raw information into useful features for a model.
cards.reason: A model can only learn from the information it receives. Exploring and preparing data helps you find useful signals before training begins.
goals: Create features that represent useful signals

cards.title: Core ML
cards.summary: Train your first models, evaluate their results, and learn how to improve them.
cards.reason: Training a model is only the beginning. This region teaches you how to judge whether its predictions are useful and improve them responsibly.
goals: Train a baseline machine learning model
Evaluate model performance with suitable metrics

cards.title: ML Career Capstone
cards.summary: Bring your new skills together by shipping a practical machine learning project.
cards.reason: A finished project proves that you can connect data, modelling and communication into one practical piece of work.
goals: Plan a focused machine learning project
Build and evaluate an end-to-end solution
Present your decisions and results clearly
